title: Thermochromic
description: A record sleeve printed in pitch-black heat-sensitive ink over a portrait. Your hand warms it: the black goes clear through maroon and teal to show the face, then cools back from the edges inward.
intent: One material finished to the edge: real leuco-dye ink on a matte sleeve, driven by a heat field that diffuses and cools on the GPU, so the only way to see the face is to keep your hand on it.
